title: Predatory
body:
Here’s a business idea: 
We create an app that identifies people with literal attention deficit, and make them sign up for a ”free trial” that quickly converts into an annual payment.

We then make them hop through multiple hoops in order to cancel their subscription.

- I find it immoral. Make it easier to unsubscribe, remove the commitment in trial, and at the very least - set up the payment to weekly by default once the trial is out, so that it doesn’t end up hurting people it claims to ”help”.
author: Aespelund
